coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels; population is DMG/DIPG/HGG and other high-grade CNS tumours in patients aged 12 months to 25 years, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Only therapeutic product is GD2-CAR T cells (excluded type); cyclophosphamide, fludarabine (or clofarabine) are lymphodepleting conditioning (supportive per R6). Premedication with Benadryl and Tylenol 'may be given' and is not a registered intervention, so not listed. GD2 is the CAR target, not a pharmacological candidate, so not candidate-matched. H3K27 alteration is an alternative entry route when GD2 IHC is not possible (cohort 1) and part of the cohort 2 requirement. CAR T cell persistence in blood/CSF is measured but relates to the cell therapy, not a candidate drug.
